title: sdc-bench: tolerance-aware evaluation of silent data corruption checking in GEMM
description: Fault-injection campaign, independent verifier, timing benchmark and analysis for evaluating silent-data-corruption checkers in matrix multiplication against an application tolerance, in FP64, FP32, FP16 and BF16. The records of the reference run (1,080,000 injections, 2,688,000 fault-free checks) are archived separately under CC BY 4.0.
